canonical_repository.rule: The Git repository is the canonical working store and its history. The main branch is the current state; checkpoint/* tags are the states handed to reviewers or to Design, and their ZIPs are built from those tags. The Drive folder (repository_drive_id) and ZIP copies are lineage, never working copies.

authority_rule: The Production Master is the sole semantic, evidence, source, rights, controlled-product-state and publication-state authority. Subordinate projections, design artifacts and code may not overrule it.
projection_rule: YFI_CURRENT_PROJECT_CONTEXT.json and controlled Page Specs are projections. If their recorded Master hash differs, resolve from the Master and regenerate.
master_first_correction_rule: Any material evidence/content correction is made in the Production Master first and then regenerated into subordinate projections.
public_runtime_rule: The public runtime consumes filtered local governed payloads; it does not parse or ship the Production Master.
release_rule: Controlled content is not sufficient for live-release readiness; runtime/browser, mobile/RTL, accessibility, publication filtering, security/privacy, rights/legal where applicable, corrections/version behavior and named approval must match the readiness claim.
external_repository_sync_rule: Drive file IDs are lineage references. They are not asserted to contain the bytes bound here until a controlled replacement is performed and verified; until then the state is EXTERNAL_REPOSITORY_SYNC_PENDING.
